html:
SPRING

Spring Security 로그인 · Spring

요약: web.xml DelegatingFilterProxy, intercept-url 권한, form-login, CSRF 토큰, 로그아웃

1. pom.xml · web.xml

xml
<!-- pom.xml : spring-security-core, spring-security-web, spring-security-config -->

<!-- web.xml -->
<context-param>
  <param-name>contextConfigLocation</param-name>
  <param-value>
    /WEB-INF/spring/root-context.xml
    /WEB-INF/spring/context-security.xml
  </param-value>
</context-param>

<filter>
  <filter-name>springSecurityFilterChain</filter-name>
  <filter-class>org.springframework.web.filter.DelegatingFilterProxy</filter-class>
</filter>
<filter-mapping>
  <filter-name>springSecurityFilterChain</filter-name>
  <url-pattern>/*</url-pattern>
</filter-mapping>

2. context-security.xml — 권한 · 로그인 폼

xml
<beans:beans xmlns="http://www.springframework.org/schema/security"
             xmlns:beans="http://www.springframework.org/schema/beans" ...>
  <http auto-config="true" use-expressions="false">
    <intercept-url pattern="/member/login" access="ROLE_ANONYMOUS" />
    <intercept-url pattern="/admin/**" access="ROLE_ADMIN" />
    <intercept-url pattern="/**" access="ROLE_USER" />
    <form-login
      username-parameter="mid"
      password-parameter="pwd"
      login-page="/member/login"
      default-target-url="/member/memberMain"
      authentication-failure-url="/member/login?fail=true" />
  </http>

  <authentication-manager>
    <authentication-provider>
      <user-service>
        <user name="atom" password="1234" authorities="ROLE_USER" />
        <user name="admin" password="admin" authorities="ROLE_ADMIN" />
      </user-service>
    </authentication-provider>
  </authentication-manager>
</beans:beans>
설정의미
use-expressions="false"security 표현식 대신 ROLE_ 이름으로 지정
username / password-parameter로그인 폼에서 보내는 input name
login-page로그인 화면 주소 (컨트롤러)
default-target-url로그인 성공 시 이동
authentication-failure-url로그인 실패 시 이동
ROLE_USER / ROLE_ADMIN / ROLE_ANONYMOUS예약된 권한 이름 — 권한 없으면 403(인가 오류)

3. 로그인 · 로그아웃 jsp

jsp
<!-- 로그인: /프로젝트/login 으로 post (예약 주소) -->
<form method="post" action="${ctp}/login">
  아이디 <input type="text" name="mid" />
  비밀번호 <input type="password" name="pwd" />
  <input type="submit" value="로그인" />
  <input type="hidden" name="${_csrf.parameterName}" value="${_csrf.token}" />   <!-- CSRF 토큰 필수 -->
</form>

<!-- 로그아웃: /프로젝트/logout -->
<%@ taglib uri="http://www.springframework.org/tags/form" prefix="form" %>
<form:form method="post" action="${ctp}/logout">     <!-- form:form 은 CSRF 토큰 자동 추가 -->
  <input type="submit" value="로그아웃" />
</form:form>
java
@RequestMapping(value = "/member/login", method = RequestMethod.GET)
public String memberLoginGet() { return "member/login"; }

원본 메모의 filter-mapping 에서 <filter-class>/*</filter-class> 를 <url-pattern>/*</url-pattern> 으로 고쳤다. intercept-url 은 위에서부터 검사하므로 /** 를 맨 아래에 둔다.
